rules.title: Security Deposit Maximum Limit and Handling
rules.requirement: A security deposit cannot exceed one month's rent, must be held in a separate interest-bearing account with interest paid to the tenant annually, and must be returned within 30 days of the end of the tenancy along with accrued interest or an itemized list of deductions.

coverage.summary: Applies generally to residential tenancies where a security deposit is requested.

rules.quoted_span: A security deposit cannot be more than the amount of 1 month’s rent. It must be kept in a separate interest-bearing account. The landlord should pay the interest accrued to the tenant each year.
